maxCouponsPerOrder.title: Maximum coupons per checkout
maxCouponsPerOrder.description: How many coupon codes a customer can apply to a single order.

allowStackingWithSales.title: Stack coupons on discounted items
allowStackingWithSales.description: Allow coupon discounts to apply on items that already have a promotional sale price.

requireAccountToRedeem.title: Require sign-in to redeem coupons
requireAccountToRedeem.description: Require customers to create or sign in to their account to use discount codes.

caseSensitiveCodes.title: Case-sensitive coupon codes
caseSensitiveCodes.description: Match coupon codes with exact letter casing instead of converting to uppercase.
